title: Italian Enterprises Leading in AI—Built on MongoDB Atlas
summary: Discover how leading Italian enterprises are pioneering AI innovation—transforming finance, energy, and manufacturing with MongoDB Atlas as their data foundation.
body_markdown:
We often talk about AI as if it were magic. A black box that simply knows things. But the reality is that AI models are engines: high-performance, hungry, and only as good as the fuel you feed them and the block that holds them together.


In the enterprise world, that engine block is the data platform.


Across Italy, a new generation of business pioneers is emerging, companies that aren’t just adopting AI, but reimagining their industries. They’re building on a foundation that can handle the speed, scale, and complexity that AI innovation demands, delivering custom-made, next-generation user experiences.


Four such trailblazers are TeamSystem, altermAInd, Brembo Solutions, and Eni. And they’re using[MongoDB Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform) to turn their data into a superpower.


## The orchestrator: TeamSystem


While many companies are experimenting with AI, TeamSystem is doing something far more ambitious: orchestrating it across an entire product ecosystem. As one of Europe’s leading providers of digital business solutions—serving more than 2.5 million customers—TeamSystem set out to embed AI deeply and pragmatically into its platforms, helping users navigate complex, highly regulated environments with ease.


Gianluca Genga, AI & Platform Engineering Manager, describes the mission simply: “There’s a lot of hype around AI. We wanted to be more pragmatic.” For TeamSystem, that meant building an AI layer that could understand and retrieve business content—documents, images, videos—through natural conversation, all while maintaining strict data isolation and security for each customer.


But with over 300 products and a rapidly expanding European footprint, data fragmentation made this vision difficult. Embedding AI into each product individually would have been unsustainable. Instead, TeamSystem created a centralized AI excellence platform powered by MongoDB Atlas.


By combining[full‑text search](https://www.mongodb.com/lp/cloud/atlas/search) , metadata filtering, and[vector search](https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform/atlas-vector-search) ,[TeamSystem built a hybrid retrieval engine](https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/customer-case-studies/teamsystem) that delivers precise, context‑aware results while minimizing the risk of hallucinations. MongoDB Atlas handles the heavy lifting—scalability, security, and multi‑tenancy—allowing TeamSystem’s teams to focus on innovation rather than infrastructure.


The impact has been transformative. The platform has scaled from 50,000 to 500,000 users without performance degradation, and AI‑powered process automation has cut task times by 30–40%. Users praise the system for “understanding them straightaway,” while internal teams—from support to sales—benefit from faster workflows and smarter recommendations.


“MongoDB has allowed us to build a secure, scalable, fully cost‑controlled, and above all, future‑oriented platform,” said Genga.


## The guardian: altermAInd


In the rush to adopt AI, one hurdle can trip up even the most agile companies: regulation.


altermAInd, born from the digital team at illimity Bank, set out to prove that compliance doesn’t have to limit innovation. Its goal was to lead Europe’s AI revolution by helping enterprises adopt AI that is fully compliant with regulations such as the GDPR and the EU AI Act.


Filipe Teixeira, CEO of altermAInd, faced a classic dilemma: How do you build a system that is incredibly fast and innovative, but also rigidly controlled and secure? He needed a "triangulation" of innovation, control, and performance. MongoDB Atlas became that backbone.


MongoDB Atlas allows altermAInd to process massive volumes of real-time data while enforcing strict access controls and schema validation. "We don't want innovation with a fragile backbone," says Teixeira, and MongoDB Atlas allows the company to scale to over 200,000 customers without the infrastructure buckling under regulatory pressure.


By solving the compliance puzzle at the database layer,[altermAInd has freed its clients](https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/customer-case-studies/altermaind) to innovate without fear of regulatory repercussions.


## The accelerator: Brembo Solutions


When one thinks of Brembo, high-performance braking systems come to mind. But with Brembo Solutions, the company has taken its internal Data Science and AI expertise and turned it into a powerhouse SaaS offering for the world.


Their challenge? Taking "AI•DOING"—their practical application of AI—and scaling it for clients in industries as diverse as food, cosmetics, and chemicals.


Enter[ALCHEMIX, Brembo’s AI-powered recipe formulator.](https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/customer-case-studies/brembo-solutions) In R&D, finding the perfect material mix can take months of trial and error. ALCHEMIX cuts that down to minutes.


To achieve this, Nicolò Nepote, VP of Data Science and AI at Brembo, needed a database that refused to compromise. He calls it the philosophy of "the perfect fit, versus good enough." Complex material data, historical formulations, and performance results needed to be retrieved in real-time to feed AI models. MongoDB’s document model handled this diverse data without friction.


The result is an R&D revolution where speed is the new standard. "Without MongoDB Atlas, it wouldn't have been possible for ALCHEMIX to deliver the speed of data retrieval our users expect," said Nepote.


## The navigator: Eni


Energy giant Eni has an ambitious mission: to transition to net zero emissions by 2050. Achieving this requires precision, and in the world of geoscience, precision comes from data. Terabytes of it.


Eni’s geologists and engineers deal with mountains of unstructured data—documents generated by different countries in different units of measurement. In the past, a lack of standardization made it difficult to create complete data sets and run queries.


Sabato Severino, Senior AI Solution Architect at Eni, saw a way to change the game using AI and natural language processing (NLP). But he needed a platform that could understand the data, not just store it.


Seeking a seamless, managed service, Eni transformed its data strategy by switching to MongoDB Atlas. Its cloud-agnostic nature avoided vendor lock-in, perfectly fitting the team’s multi-cloud vision. Plus, as they were already familiar with MongoDB, the transition was a smooth one.


Beyond meeting strict security and compliance standards,[MongoDB Atlas empowers Eni to analyze years of data instantly](https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/customer-case-studies/eni) . By integrating Atlas Search and AI vector search, teams can now cut through the noise to spot critical patterns. Perhaps best of all, the days of complex, hand-coded dashboards are over. With Atlas Charts, Eni can build real-time, interactive visualizations code-free, making data insights accessible across the entire company.


Now, rather than hunting for information, Eni’s scientists focus instead on the science. "Used correctly, this data helps us work faster and smarter," says Severino. "Precision is vital for scientists working in this industry."


## The common thread


Across industries as different as manufacturing, energy, financial services, and business software, one pattern stands out: AI innovation breaks down when data infrastructure can’t keep up.


Each of these Italian innovators realized that legacy databases couldn't handle the fluid, dynamic nature of AI. To build the future, they needed a solution that is:


• Flexible enough to handle unstructured, complex, and rapidly evolving data


• Performant enough to serve AI models and user experiences in real time


• Secure enough to protect sensitive information across industries and regulatory environments


• Scalable enough to support everything from specialized R&D tools to nationwide digital platforms


MongoDB became the foundation that allowed each of them to transform ambition into reality. Together, these companies are redefining what “Made in Italy” means in the age of AI—bold, inventive, and built on a platform ready for whatever comes next.
